title: RapidFuzz
subtitle: Fuzzy string comparisons beside your data.
intro: Score candidate pairs using edit-distance and token-based matching. Normalize text first, select a score that matches your data, then rank or threshold the candidates.

reference.name: rapidfuzz_ratio(a, b)
reference.description: General string similarity on a 0–100 scale.

reference.name: rapidfuzz_partial_ratio(a, b)
reference.description: Find a shorter string within a longer string.

reference.name: rapidfuzz_token_sort_ratio(a, b)
reference.description: Compare after sorting words; tolerates word-order changes.

reference.name: rapidfuzz_token_set_ratio(a, b)
reference.description: Compare token sets; discounts repeated words.

reference.name: rapidfuzz_osa_distance(a, b)
reference.description: Edit distance with adjacent transpositions; smaller is closer.

reference.name: rapidfuzz_jaro_winkler_normalized_similarity
reference.description: Normalized similarity from 0 to 1; larger is closer.

notes.title: Score scales differ
notes.body: Ratio functions use 0–100. Normalized similarities use 0–1. Distance functions point the other way: zero means an exact match. A score is not a match probability.

notes.title: Reduce candidate pairs first
notes.body: A cross join compares every pair. Block on useful fields before scoring large tables. Explicitly lower-case, trim, or standardize punctuation when your matching rules require it.

examples.title: Reordered words
examples.caption: Token sorting handles word order without changing the score scale.

examples.title: Find the closest candidate
examples.sql:
SELECT name,
  rapidfuzz_ratio('query farm', lower(name))
    AS score
FROM (VALUES ('Query Farm'), ('Query Firm'),
             ('Quiet Barn')) AS t(name)
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 2;
examples.caption: This small fixture is self-contained. Apply the same pattern to blocked pairs.

examples.title: Measure a transposition
examples.caption: OSA counts one adjacent transposition as one edit.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN rapidfuzz_token_sort_ratio('world hello','hello world')=100 AND rapidfuzz_osa_distance('form','from')=1 THEN true ELSE error('fuzzy scores') END;
